correctness.rationale: The trace and principal minors give the stated pair of eigenvalues on the mean-zero plane. On that plane the two Lagrange spectral projectors give K12=1/3-A exp(-lambda_- t)+B exp(-lambda_+ t), also at q=q_c provided the zero eigenspace is split into the constants and the zero mode on the plane. In the stable region each nonconstant entry is a sum of three exponentials with distinct rates. Its derivative has at most one zero, giving at most two entry zeros counting multiplicity. The initial slopes (-q,a,b) and common positive limit then give the simple recovery on edge 12 and exclude all later zeros on edges 13 and 23. Diagonals are positive by the spectral representation. At the boundary the formula is -B(1-exp(-lambda_+ t)); above it lambda_- >= -2q from the single rank-one negative perturbation, so B>0 and K12 is strictly decreasing. Row sums one give the exact absolute row norm and differentiation gives the unique stable peak. At weak repulsion the expansion of K12/t has linear terms -q+ab t/2, and the derivative has -q+ab t; these and the small positive roots give both time expansions and the quadratic norm excess. At the critical edge lambda_-/epsilon tends to 3(a+b)/(2S_c). Negativity of the critical entry at every fixed finite t>0 forces T to diverge; the crossing equation then gives lambda_- T -> log(3 A_c). The explicit peak gives logarithmic divergence, vanishing lambda_- t_peak, and the asserted peak height. Independent scalar bisection for the stated symmetric example reproduced T=0.687767925034 and the peak norm 1.058792136080. The uploaded script was inspected, not executed.
residual_risks: The zero count is used only for nontrivial polynomials with distinct rates in the stable regime; the critical case is checked separately. The audit is analytic, not a formal certificate or a larger-graph result.

evidence: The reciprocal effective resistance gives the PSD threshold; corank one with PSD gives eventual exponential positivity in the symmetric row-sum-zero setting. The signed-digraph consensus theory likewise addresses eventual positivity.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The positive subgraph has terminal effective resistance 1/a+1/b, giving q_c, and its corank changes at equality. These comparisons establish the static threshold and existence of a horizon below it, not the signs at every time or the divergence rates of the last sign-change time and the norm-peak time.

evidence: The fractional triangle theorem permits every strictly positive conductance triple and every positive power. It gives exceptional-edge signs, unique recovery, the exact norm, and the peak of exp(-t M^alpha).
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: This covers the stable frozen triangle pointwise, not just by analogy: for its stable signed Laplacian L, form M=L^delta on the mean-zero plane and set it to zero on constants. As delta tends to zero through positive values, M tends to I-J/3, so all its off-diagonal entries are strictly negative for sufficiently small delta. M is then a positive-conductance triangle Laplacian, and with alpha=1/delta, M^alpha=L. The sign of the initial derivative identifies its uniquely offending edge; matching the two projectors and rates gives the same kernel and hence recovery/norm/peak. At or above q_c the rank drops or a negative mode appears, so this representation by a positive-conductance triangle fails. The theorem's displayed critical-order limits do not give timing or amplification along the frozen q-family.

value.rationale: The one-repulsive-edge triangle is the smallest loop in which positive alternative paths can recover entrywise positivity. The useful new benchmark is not another PSD threshold: the time of most severe transient amplification becomes negligible relative to the recovery time at criticality, while the maximum gain remains bounded away from one. Sharp coefficients and the change from recovery to persistent negativity quantify the difference between initial gain and positivity delay in physical time.
residual_risks: No transfer of the two time scales to larger signed networks is established.
